code: import html from typing import Any import re def escape_html(user_input: str) -> str: """EGRR_PATTERN: Escape HTML to prevent XSS.""" return html.escape(user_input, quote=True) def sanitize_for_html_attribute(value: str) -> str: """EGRR_PATTERN: Sanitize value for use in HTML attribute.""" # Remove all non-alphanumeric characters except safe ones sanitized = re.sub(r'[^a-zA-Z0-9\s\-_.]', '', value) return html.escape(sanitized, quote=True) def safe_render_user_content(content: str) -> str: """EGRR_PATTERN: Render user content safely with limited HTML.""" # Escape everything first escaped = html.escape(content, quote=True) # Allow only specific safe tags (whitelist approach) allowed_tags = ['b', 'i', 'u', 'br'] for tag in allowed_tags: escaped = escaped.replace(f'<{tag}>', f'<{tag}>') escaped = escaped.replace(f'</{tag}>', f'') return escaped def create_safe_link(url: str, text: str) -> str: """EGRR_PATTERN: Create safe HTML link with proper escaping.""" # Validate URL scheme if not url.startswith(('http://', 'https://', '/')): raise ValueError('Invalid URL scheme') safe_url = html.escape(url, quote=True) safe_text = html.escape(text, quote=True) return f'{safe_text}'
explanation: Prevent Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) by escaping HTML entities in user input before rendering. Use html.escape() for output encoding and validate/sanitize input.
